title: Distinct patterns of whole-body coding in human motor cortex and posterior parietal cortex
title_zh: 人类运动皮层与后顶叶皮层全身编码的不同模式
abstract: Traditional views of cortical motor areas hold that movements of different parts of the body, or effectors, are represented in distinct anatomical locations. The extent of overlap in effector representations has been a topic of debate for decades. We recorded from single neurons in hand areas of the motor cortex (MC) and posterior parietal cortex (PPC) of tetraplegic humans while they attempted movements across the body. We found a population response to every movement tested in both areas; however, the hand knob of MC more selectively responded to hand movements, whereas PPC represented all effectors strongly. Single neurons in MC responded selectively to a single effector or to two effectors that were part of the same limb. In PPC, neurons exhibited mixed selectivity, responding to combinations of effectors. These findings suggest a transition from a highly effector-general representation in PPC to regional effector specificity in MC.
abstract_zh: 传统的皮层运动区观点认为，身体不同部位或效应器的运动在解剖上位于不同位置。效应器表征的重叠程度多年来一直是争论的焦点。我们在四肢瘫痪人类的运动皮层（MC）和后顶叶皮层（PPC）手部区域记录单个神经元，观察其在尝试全身运动时的活动。结果显示，两区均对每种测试运动产生群体响应；但MC的手部旋钮更为专一地响应手部运动，而PPC则强烈地代表所有效应器。MC中的单个神经元对单一效应器或同一肢体内的两个效应器表现出选择性；而PPC中的神经元表现出混合选择性，响应多种效应器组合。这些发现表明，PPC呈现高度通用的效应器表征，而MC则向区域性效应器特异性转变。
